params.body:
The app-health probe followed redirects, and the client drops the Authorization header when it follows one to another host. A declared address that answers 301 to its canonical (`www.sportbusinessgame.eu` to `sportbusinessgame.eu`, this morning) therefore came back as "the app refused the token; it was probably rotated on one side only". The token was right; the address was not. The probe no longer follows redirects and names one as what it is: "the declared address redirects to …; declare the address that answers in elixir.json". The credentials measurement, which reads that note, then stops blaming the token.

The other half is ShaneDeconinck/good-governance#22 (elixir.json on the canonical). Test in `AppHealthScanTest`. Suite green, PHPStan green.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: Een adres dat doorstuurt is geen app die nee zegt
